name: @meridianmcp/latex
description: Structural LaTeX editing engine for Overleaf — real parse/print AST over .tex, addressable nodes (sections, tables, equations, figures, citations), claim/write coordination, and a direct Socket.IO/OT client for no-browser-tab writes. NOT independently published -- ships as a subpath (@meridianmcp/mcp/latex) and CLI (meridian-latex) of the @meridianmcp/mcp package instead (see npm/scripts/bundle-latex.mjs and npm/package.json). This directory is the source of truth for that bundle, and stays a real npm workspace member for local dev/testing, but "private": true stops it from ever being published on its own by mistake.
author: Adam Camerer
